array.string: PY=$(command -v python3); if [ -z "$PY" ]; then for c in /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3 /usr/bin/python3 /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/Current/bin/python3; do if [ -x "$c" ]; then PY="$c"; break; fi; done; fi; if [ -z "$PY" ]; then echo "python3 not found" >&2; exit 1; fi; exec "$PY" "__PROXY_PATH__"
